messages:
jin: Quick sync — ran an initial bring-up for ozma-13b-q4f with speculative decoding + RAG. quick notes below, want ops/benchmarks signoff before broader rollout.

emma: nice, numbers?

jin: p95 latency w/ speculative enabled: 82ms (baseline non-spec 125ms). tokens/sec up ~1.9x on our typical webchat mix.

ravi: huge. what about quality? any regressions on QA F1 / hallucination checks?

jin: small hit on exact-match for narrow QA set: -0.8 pts. QA F1 down -0.4. hallucination rate (our fuzzed prompts) +0.6%. still within tolerance for dedicated tier but flagged.

lee: did you test fallback behavior when speculation misses? i.e., speculative candidate mismatch fallback to base decode path.

jin: yep — fallback successful ~98.5% of miss cases; added an early-abort threshold so we failover within 3 tokens. that keeps tail latency bounded.

emma: what's the eval command so I can reproduce locally?

jin: ```
python run_eval.py --model ozma-13b-q4f --quant q4f --speculative true --spec_mode hybrid --fallback_threshold 0.3 --eval_sets qa_small,hallucination_set,conv_latency --N 1000
```

ravi: interesting — hybrid speculative mode means early-path greedy + branch sampling?

jin: yes. we run a cheap 1-step sampler to predict next n prefixes, then continue on fastpath if confidence>threshold, else fallback to full sample. reduces compute on success.

lee: any tokenization or kv-cache quirks with q4f quant artifacts? saw a small drift in token logits on warm prefixes in previous experiments.

jin: noticed that too. done two mitigations: 1) prefix-normalization trick (rescale logits on first 8 tokens), 2) extend kv-cache warm window from 4->12 for small slack. both reduced observed drift to noise.

emma: OK. can we get a small AB on prod shadow for 10k sessions? need end-to-end metrics incl p99 and quality deltas. also add rerank gating for RAG QA pipeline.

jin: scheduling shadow run now — added this config to canary group. CLI: ``redwood deploy --group canary-spec --model ozma-13b-q4f --speculative true --spec_mode hybrid --canary_sessions 10000``

ops-bot: Canary job queued: job_id=canary-17602-ozma, scheduled by jin.

ravi: also recommend running the adversarial holdout (prompt templates that previously triggered hallucinations). put that in the smoke set.

jin: added halluc_holdout_2026 to evaluation pipeline. quick sample results attached to job when done.

lee: one more ask — add a unit in the run that recomputes cost-per-token delta with speculation on/off. CFO wants an upfront estimate.

emma: good call. jin can you push that as part of the canary config?

jin: done. will report p95/p99/avg cost-per-1k-tokens and quality deltas in the canary summary.

ravi: sweet. if regressions exceed thresholds (QA EM -1.5 or halluc +2.0%) auto-disable speculative via rollout policy?

emma: yes we'll use rollout policy: auto-fallback to non-spec when thresholds tripped.

jin: noted. will follow up with the canary summary later today. :eyes:
